snippets.title: React Training Workshop Outline
snippets.code:
# React Fundamentals Workshop (4 hours)

## Module 1: Introduction (30 min)
- What is React and why use it?
- Setting up development environment

## Module 2: Components & JSX (60 min)
- Functional vs Class components
- Props and component composition
- Exercise: Build a Card component

## Module 3: State & Events (60 min)
- useState hook
- Event handling
- Exercise: Build a Counter app

# Internal Certification Program

## Frontend Developer Certification
- Complete 40-hour React training
- Build 3 portfolio projects
- Pass written examination (80% minimum)
- Code review with senior engineers

activity.author: Training Attendee
activity.comment: The hands-on approach made complex concepts click. Building real projects during the workshops was much more effective than just watching tutorials.

activity.author: Zachariah Ayers
activity.comment: Trained 300+ developers on React, Node.js, and modern JavaScript. Created structured curriculum with hands-on workshops achieving 4.8/5 satisfaction rating.

businessRequirements.businessContext: Continuous learning and skill development are critical for maintaining competitive technical capabilities and employee satisfaction

businessValue: Increased skill adoption rate from 30% to 85%
Reduced time-to-productivity from 3 months to 1 month
